terms.comment: The passive of pāscere, feed, used of the animals that feed themselves.

terms.gloss: to graze (intransitive, of animals); to pasture (cattle)
evidence: Verg. E. 3.96: pāscentēs capellae; Verg. G. 3.143 (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Intransitive “graze” is poetic (Lewis & Short); in prose the animals pāscuntur.

sources: Lewis & Short: pasco
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
